mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.user_id AS userId, h.name AS hotelName, r.name AS roomType, b.checkin_date AS checkinDate, b.checkout_date AS checkoutDate, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM hotel_bookings b JOIN hotels h ON h.id = b.hotel_id JOIN hotel_rooms r ON r.id = b.room_type_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
